description.value: Edo Japan is a Canadian-founded, Japanese-inspired fast-casual chain established in Calgary in 1979, now with over 200 locations nationwide. The Outlook Village location in Mission serves teppanyaki-grilled meals, hand-rolled sushi, ramen, and bubble tea from a shopping-centre unit on the Lougheed Highway. Dine-in seating, takeout, and delivery are all available, making it a practical hot-meal stop on a Highway 7 corridor ride.
